issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]にノートを{見[み]せてもらいませんでした|gv-temorau}。
issues.problem: 見せてもらいませんでした sounds unnatural as a plain statement (the natural form is 見せてもらえませんでした, a different form); a duplicate of the negative pattern already in line 25
issues.action: rewrote as テストの前に、友達にノートを見せてもらった with matching English, distractors and why

issues.jp_before: 娘[むすめ]は友達[ともだち]に髪[かみ]を{結[ゆ]んでもらいました|gv-temorau}。
issues.problem: wrong form/reading: 結[ゆ]んで does not exist (結ぶ むすんで / 結う ゆって); why also wrongly said the speaker receives the favour
issues.action: changed answer and distractors to 結[ゆ]って..., rewrote why
